notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 order-type lookup foundation to the exact C++ API surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. The embedded profile recognizes only the two mandatory standard order names, Receive and TimeStamp; the companion HLA_IMMEDIATE case decodes the accepted type-53/type-38 service-report forms. Order-change services, per-instance preferred-order state, alternate time/TSO modes, save/restore, transport, packaging, protected review, and conformance remain unimplemented.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual OrderType getOrderType( std::wstring const & orderTypeName) = 0
